fit_reason: Although posted under boats by owner, the listing says to call Knotty Oar Marina, so this appears to be dealer or marina stock rather than a private owner sale. The boat is also essentially new with about one hour of use and looks clean in every photo.
findings: Hull panels on both sides look clean and glossy, with no visible oxidation or scum
The custom cover is on over the interior, so the seats and deck cannot be judged
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Sea-Doo Switch Cruise. It looks sharp in the photos, with clean, glossy hull panels on both sides. If you ever want a pre-sale wash and wax or an interior detail before showings, we come to you. Would you like a quote?
